rules.statement: Section 56 of the Debt Conciliation Ordinance does not bar a civil court from entertaining an action on a mortgage bond, but only actions in respect of the validity of any procedure before the Board or the legality of any settlement.
rules.supporting_quote: "The contention raised relates to the want of jurisdiction of the Court while the provision of the Ordinance prevents the regularity or the validity of the conduct of the business before the Board being called in question"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 56 (a) (ii) of the Debt Conciliation Ordinance, Cap. 81.
